title: Swahili Phrases You Will Use on Safari
excerpt: A few words of Swahili go a long way. The phrases you will use most on safari and on Zanzibar.
body:
## Greetings

- **Jambo** – hello (used with visitors)
- **Habari?** – how are you?
- **Nzuri** – fine
- **Mambo?** – what's up? Answer: **Poa** – cool
- **Shikamoo** – respectful greeting to an elder. Answer: **Marahaba**

## Polite words

- **Asante (sana)** – thank you (very much)
- **Tafadhali** – please
- **Karibu** – welcome / you're welcome
- **Samahani** – sorry / excuse me

## On safari

- **Simba** – lion
- **Tembo** – elephant
- **Twiga** – giraffe
- **Chui** – leopard
- **Kiboko** – hippo
- **Pole pole** – slowly, slowly
- **Hakuna matata** – no worries

## Useful

- **Ndiyo / Hapana** – yes / no
- **Bei gani?** – how much?
- **Maji** – water
- **Kwaheri** – goodbye

See also our [say hello in Swahili](/say-hello-in-swahili/) page and [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
